label: KSafe
description: Karoo safety extension on two layers: REACTIVE (crash detection, SOS, check-in, HR-based medical episode and wellness detection) and PREVENTIVE (carb and hydration tracking that adapts to your effort using the Karoo's HR and power zones, reminding you to fuel before bonking or dehydration impair your judgment on the bike). Sends emergency alerts via WhatsApp (CallMeBot), Telegram, Pushover or ntfy. Beta — test before relying on it.
releaseNotes:
v2.0.0 — major release across safety and ride wellness.

CRASH DETECTION: orientation-aware silence check — the algorithm learns the bike's upright gravity vector during steady cruising and uses it to tell a real crash (bike on its side) from a rider who bumped and stopped upright, suppressing the bump-then-brake-to-stop false positives without adding false negatives. Adds a GPS-stale fallback with hardened thresholds, a separate speed-drop monitor, and a countdown that survives an app process kill.

HEALTH (new): medical-episode detection (HR flatline / HR collapse) and a three-tier wellness monitor (critical HR, sustained HR, cardiac decoupling) with per-tier alerts and ride-start readiness advice.

FUELING (new): carb and hydration tracking that adapts to your effort using HR and power zones, with deficit and time-based reminders, sweat-rate estimation, on-screen log fields with undo, and FIT developer fields so Strava / Intervals.icu / TrainingPeaks see the streams.

DATA FIELDS: Karoo-theme passthrough is the new default — fresh fields render with the host's day/night theme; per-field alignment on the passive numeric readouts; '---' shown while waiting for data.
